_readme: Canonical section-header and bold-label wording for non-English Child generation (ADR-0135). Keys are the exact English template labels in the Make.com Child blueprint. Spanish/German/French/Italian/Portuguese values start from the most common wording already delivered to customers where it was a real translation (French and Portuguese often shipped English labels instead), the rest and Dutch were written for this pack and have NOT had native-speaker review. Header voice addresses the player (es tu, de du, fr vous, it tu, pt voce, nl jouw). Edit here, then rebuild with temp-files/build-child-v53.py.
